verdict.rationale: Fin documents pre-launch testing: a 'How to preview and test Fin' article and testing 'across thousands of scenarios before anything goes live'. That is a preview or simulation (dry-run) feature, not a sandbox environment. Nothing in the evidence shows a separate test workspace or isolation from production data, connectors or external-system actions, so this adjacent capability earns no credit for the sandbox story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
